name: Call for nature and environmental protection civil organisations (Hungary)
summary: Grants of HUF 1-3 million to registered public-benefit civil organisations in Hungary for nature conservation work such as habitat protection and management, habitat rehabilitation, Natura 2000 tasks and nature monitoring.
reporting: A written report and an invoice summary, sent electronically within 30 days after the funding period ends and by 30 January 2027 at the latest.

steps: Paper application by post, with an electronic copy on a data carrier

eligibility.rule: Has public-benefit status under the Civil Act
Has environmental and/or nature-protection duties in its founding deed or bylaws
Was finally registered in Hungary before 1 January 2025
Had already carried out nature-conservation activities in 2025 or earlier
Not a public foundation, civil partnership, public body, non-profit company, church body, party or business company
Is not subject to bankruptcy, liquidation or another statutory termination proceeding
Is a transparent organisation under the applicable laws
Avoids the call's excluded environmental, climate, water, animal, agricultural, ragweed, forestry and game topics

documents: Authenticated scanned copy of the statutes or founding deed

2025. január 1. előtt jogerősen Magyarországon bejegyzésre kerültek;
